about_the_game:
2 Leagues. 1 Universe. Your Terms.

Forge your legacy in Maximum Football, where you can play both college and pro football in one shared universe. Fully customize your team and build your dream roster to play solo or take it to the gridiron in local or online multiplayer. In Maximum Football, you have ultimate control over football simulation.

FOOTBALL ON YOUR TERMS

Don't just play the game, build it. Maximum Football’s deep customization suite gives you the power to create a unique identity. Craft the perfect helmet and jersey combination, use custom logos, and edit every detail of your roster to dominate the competition. Modify every piece of your football universe the way you want it, from league sizes to the rulesets.

BUILD A COLLEGE DYNASTY

In Dynasty Mode, you'll take the reins as head coach, scouring the nation for top recruits, developing their talent, and making the strategic decisions that lead to championships. You also take on the responsibilities of your school’s Athletic Director, where you upgrade and manage your stadium and facilities, as well as every detail of your school. This is a deep, multi-season experience for any college football fanatic.

RUN A PRO FRANCHISE

Try your hand at managing a pro team by building your roster from free agency and the draft, running the front office and stadium amenities, and making the game-time decisions to cement your franchise into a league leader. Connect Dynasty Mode with Franchise Mode to build one football universe, where you can draft your college superstars onto your pro roster.

AUTHENTIC FOOTBALL GAMEPLAY

Powered by the Unreal Engine 5, every snap is brought to life with our physics-based gameplay system. Feel the weight of every collision and experience the freedom of realistic player animations. This is football where your skill on the sticks truly matters.

Play today for free!

  • Processor: Intel i5 12500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 10GB
